Our best-selling product is Lumen Pasta K251, with a total quantity sold of 3,630 units.

caveats: - The query successfully identified the product with the highest total quantity sold from completed orders. - Both steps confirmed the same product (Lumen Pasta K251) as the top seller, with Step 2 verifying positive net units sold (excluding refunds). - No data quality issues or exclusions were reported in the results.
sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1
